name: Gebel Barkal and the Sites of the Napatan Region
description: Rising 104 metres from the desert beside the Nile near Karima in northern Sudan, the flat-topped sandstone mesa of Gebel Barkal was sacred to both ancient Kush and Egypt. Five sites spread over more than 60 km hold pyramids, temples, palaces and tombs from the Napatan and Meroitic kingdoms. Local people still regard the largest temples as holy.
